summary: Deploy the new Saleor version with a state_only migration, retire the old version, then alter the account_user.note column from TEXT to VARCHAR(255) without truncation, preserving existing note values.
write_consistency: While both versions are live the note column remains TEXT; after retire_old the column type changes to VARCHAR(255) exclusively for the new version, avoiding overlap‑write issues.
revision_notes: Removed the USING LEFT(note,255) truncation from the sql_alter_note stage that caused 3 note values to change, breaking the preservation check. The type change now runs after retire_old when only the new version is active, and assumes existing notes are ≤255 so values stay unchanged.

stages.description: Alter account_user.note from TEXT to VARCHAR(255).
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note TYPE VARCHAR(255);
